items.title: Symmetrical Abstract Damask Floral Arabesque Panel
items.description: An elegant, high-privacy vertical screen displaying a heavily mirrored abstract damask layout. The thick, fluid vectors form an intricate arabesque web of stylized lily buds, scrolling curves, and a central diamond crest.

items.title: Moroccan Star Trellis Slat DXF Panel for CNC Doors
items.description: Twin borders of eight-point Moroccan stars flank a central column of open horizontal slats, interrupted by a rounded trellis medallion built from interlocking rings. The strong side borders anchor the composition while the open center keeps most of the panel light and easy to cut.

items.title: Contemporary Islamic Star Grid Minimalist Screen Vector
items.description: A striking contemporary panel layout that divides space into a bold solid half and a decorative half. One side features a vertical strip of traditional Islamic star geometry, accented by horizontal dashed slits, creating a unique asymmetric security barrier.
